remarks_1999: VI in first title written in by Doris Bry in black ink in Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Mrs. Fischel. . . . Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this was torn and badly restored." Part of series renumbered by O'Keeffe and Doris Bry in 1970. Titled *The Shell & Old Shingle No. 6 – 1926* by Stieglitz on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph and *Shingle and Shell, No. 6* by Stieglitz on second Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

Shell and Old Shingle No. VI
Georgia O'Keeffe: Art, Image, Style, 2017, Peabody Essex Museum (Salem)

description: A bright white shell rests in the center of the composition on a black surface. Behind the shell, a gray and black shingle resting on its side curls inward framing the shell's white form. A white background meets the black surface along the bottom third of the work. Each element in the composition is highly stylized and abstracted, appearing more as forms than as recognizable objects.
title: Shell and Old Shingle VI
